Use-case: Predict missed transfers¶

In [ ]:
Goal
Before a rider reaches a transfer point, predict whether they will miss the planned connection to the next vehicle. 
If risk is high, suggest alternates (earlier/later departures, different lines, or mode changes).

Target: missed_transfer (1 = rider will miss the connection).
The dataset is intentionally imbalanced (positives ≈ 30%) so you have to handle class skew and thresholding.

Features (with explanations + FE ideas)
Identifiers & timestamps
in_route_id, out_route_id — route IDs for inbound and outbound legs.
Use: frequency/mean encoding; route reliability often differs.

in_stop_id, out_stop_id — stop IDs for the legs.
Use: frequency encoding; some stops are chronically tight for transfers.

transfer_hub_id — hub the transfer occurs at.
Use: one-hot/frequency; hub design affects walking times/congestion.

planned_arrival_ts, planned_departure_ts — planned times for inbound arrival and outbound departure.
Use: derive hour, day_of_week, buffer_min; don’t leak actuals.

Precomputed time signals

import datetime

class SplitTrainTest:
    def __init__(self):
        pass

    def split(self, X):
        train = X[X['date'] < datetime.date(2024, 9, 20)]
        test  = X[X['date'] >= datetime.date(2024, 9, 20)]
        return train, test

4.2 Feature Engineering¶

In [241]:
def label_encoding(self, X, mappings):
    X_encoded = X.copy()
    for feature, mapping in mappings.item():
        X_encoded[feature] = X_encoded[feature].map(mapping)
    return X_encoded
        

class fEngineer:
    def __init__(self):
        pass

    def one_hot(self, X, features):
        ohe_df = pd.get_dummies(X[features], drop_first = True, dtype = int)
        return pd.concat([X.drop(columns = features), ohe_df], axis = 1)

    def mean_encoding(self, X, y, features):
        X_encoded = X.copy().reset_index(drop = True)
        y = pd.Series(y).reset_index(drop = True)

        for feature in features:
            mapping = y.groupby(X_encoded[feature]).mean()
            X_encoded[feature] = X_encoded[feature].map(mapping)

        return X_encoded

    def label_encoding(self, X, mappings):
        X_encoded = X.copy()
        for feature, mapping in mappings.items():
            X_encoded[feature] = X_encoded[feature].map(mapping)  
        return X_encoded

fengnieer = fEngineer()

list_mean_encoding = ['in_route_id', 'out_route_id', 'in_stop_id' ,'out_stop_id', 'transfer_hub_id', 'transfer_type', 'varient_in' , 'varient_out', 'hub_type', 'direction_out', 'direction_in']
list_one_hot = ['in_vehicle_type', 'out_vehicle_type','is_express_out']

X_train, X_val, X_test = fengnieer.one_hot(X_train, list_one_hot), fengnieer.one_hot(X_val, list_one_hot), fengnieer.one_hot(X_test, list_one_hot)

4.3 Feature Selection (on train only)¶

In [242]:
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import VarianceThreshold

class featureSelector:
    def __init__(self, random_state):
        self.random_state = random_state

    def variance_threshold(self, X, threshold = 0.0):
        vt = VarianceThreshold(threshold = 0.0)
        return X.columns[vt.fit(X).get_support()]
        
    def corr_with_y(self, X, y):
        return X.corrwith(y).abs().sort_values(ascending = False)

    def mututal_info(self, X, y):
        mi = mutual_info_classif(X, y, random_state = self.random_state)
        return pd.Series(mi, index = X.columns).sort_values(ascending = False)

    def feature_importance(self, X, y):
        model = XGBClassifier(random_state = self.random_state).fit(X,y)
        return pd.Series(model.feature_importances_,index = X.columns).sort_values(ascending = False)

    def lasso(self, X, y):
        Xs = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
        model = LogisticRegression(penalty='l1', solver = 'liblinear', C = 1.0).fit(Xs,y)
        coefs = np.abs(model.coef_[0])
        return pd.Series(coefs,index = X.columns).sort_values(ascending = False)

fselector = featureSelector(random_state = 10)
vt_list = fselector.variance_threshold(X_train, 0.0).to_list()
X_train = X_train[vt_list]

corr_with_y_list = fselector.corr_with_y(X_train, y_train).head(20).index.to_list()
mi_list = fselector.mututal_info(X_train, y_train).head(20).index.to_list()
xgb_list = fselector.feature_importance(X_train, y_train).head(20).index.to_list()
lasso_list = fselector.lasso(X_train, y_train).head(20).index.to_list()

4.4 Model Training¶

In [246]:
class trainer:
    def __init__(self, random_state):
        self.random_state = random_state
        self.model =  None

    def train(self, X, y):
        #spw = (y_train == 0).sum() / (y_train == 1).sum()
        self.model = XGBClassifier(n_estimators=100, max_depth=5, learning_rate=0.01).fit(X,y) #scale_pos_weight = spw
        return self.model

trainer = trainer(random_state = 10)
model = trainer.train(X_train, y_train)
